android_typed_content_adapter.observed_issue: The first LiteRT-LM 0.16.1 GPU smoke completed generation but reported 3389 native input tokens instead of the expected 3174 for BXP-001, and the decoded output was wrapped as a text-content JSON array beginning [{"type": "text", "text": "<a2ui>....
android_typed_content_adapter.root_cause: LiteRT-LM Kotlin Message.toJson serializes Contents.of(text) as content:[{type:text,text:...}]. The package's training Jinja applies trim directly to message['content'], which renders the array representation instead of the raw text.

android_0_16_1_aar_verification.javap_result: Message.toJson calls Contents.toJson; Contents.toJson constructs a JsonArray and adds each Content.toJson object. Conversation.renderMessageIntoString passes Message.toJson directly to nativeConversationRenderMessageIntoString.

android_typed_content_adapter.behavior: Preserve the original scalar string path; for Android typed content, iterate the array and emit each text part through the same trim filter. Role normalization and all turn delimiters remain unchanged.

native_render_contract.render_message_behavior: With prefillPrefaceOnInit=false and empty history, renderMessageIntoString(Message.user(...)) returns the complete first-turn template including the preface and generation marker. It must not be concatenated with renderPrefaceIntoString().
native_render_contract.bos_behavior: PromptTemplateInput supplies an empty bos_token to native MiniJinja. The session separately inserts token id 2 on the first turn. Therefore '<bos>' + renderMessageIntoString(...) must equal the full Hugging Face training prompt.

android_typed_content_adapter.verification_limit: The 50-case adapter comparison is an offline byte/token parity check using Jinja2 3.1.6 and the package tokenizer. Runtime MiniJinja support for the same string/iterable pattern is evidenced by LiteRT-LM's bundled Gemma templates; the corrected device-generation rerun was not part of this read-only audit.

bixby50_prompt_token_audit.basis: Exact current repository scaffold rendered with the package's embedded chat template and tokenizer; add_special_tokens=false.

native_stop_semantics.generation_behavior: The LiteRT evaluator appends each returned chunk, detects the closing tag, then calls session.cancel_process(). The accumulated raw chunk is preserved and can include a suffix returned in that same chunk.
native_stop_semantics.scoring_behavior: External evaluation separately trims the serving/scored generated_text at the first quote-aware </a2ui>, while raw_generated_text preserves the exact runtime text.

runtime_compatibility.observed_failure: INVALID_ARGUMENT: output tensor Embedding model 1st dim 128 but number tokens 130
runtime_compatibility.root_cause: In v0.15.0 the prefill runner-size map is read from the uncompiled model before LiteRT compilation. The original 131-token signature is retained in scheduling even though magic-number compilation rewrites 131 to 128. PrefillInternal retains one pending token, so a 131-token work group attempts to place 130 token embeddings into a 128-row destination.
runtime_compatibility.signature_selection_warning: The embedder has decode and prefill signatures, while initialization without a signature key warns and chooses decode. This warning is real, but the 130-versus-128 exception is explained by the stale prefill runner-size map.
runtime_compatibility.prefill_preface_on_init: false is already the v0.15.0 default and does not change the runner-size map.
runtime_compatibility.no_model_mutation_recommendation: Use LiteRT-LM >=0.16 where the prefill runner map is derived after model compilation. Android 0.16.1 is the minimum source-confirmed compatible upgrade selected for this app and completed the GPU prefill/decode smoke without the 130-versus-128 shape failure. If runtime upgrade cannot be used, export a package whose exposed and compiled prefill dimensions agree.
runtime_compatibility.upgrade_validation: LiteRT-LM Android 0.16.1 ran the supplied package on GPU. Its first decoded result exposed a separate typed-content chat-template mismatch, documented in android_typed_content_adapter; this does not invalidate the runtime shape fix.

reproduction.prompt_tokenization: Render the verified Jinja template over the current four-message scaffold, append the assistant generation prompt, then call tokenizer.encode(rendered, add_special_tokens=False).

provenance_limit.conclusion: Only package fields, embedded tokenizer/template, graph structure, signatures, hashes, and section contents are package-proven. Prompt text, few-shot messages, thinking=false, 8192/2048 budgets, deterministic decoding, and A2UI profile are the current checked-out workflow contract reconstructed from repository source. Exact Jinja parity strongly supports compatibility but does not prove original training provenance.
